name: convergence
what_this_is: The dataset for metric 2, `convergenta` - the course's Trajectory lab,
verbatim: ONE intent, many phrasings, and the score is how efficiently
the agent reaches the same destination each time. Score per run =
optimal_path / observed path_length, capped at 1.0. `optimal_path` is
the labelled healthy minimum for this intent - message, one skill
call, the method text coming back, the answer: 6 history entries -
and the report also prints the empirical minimum, the way the course
computes it, so the label can be corrected from evidence.
The phrasings are Romanian because they are what the client types,
and they vary the way real dictation varies: with and without
diacritics, terse and chatty, formal and shorthand.
This metric owns `nothing superfluous` - a call repeated six times,
a reference fetched twice - while tool_use (metric 1) owns `nothing
required is missing`. Same intent, opposite blind sides.
